title: German tourist missing in Indonesia’s Bali after landslide amid rainy season - South China Morning Post
text:
German tourist missing in Indonesia’s Bali after landslide amid rainy season | South China Morning Post Health & Environment - Health & Environment German tourist missing in Indonesia’s Bali after landslide amid rainy season Advertisement Indonesia This Week in Asia Health & Environment German tourist missing in Indonesia’s Bali after landslide amid rainy season 
 Two men might have been in a tent that fell into a river, according to an operator of a glamping resort where they were staying
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN Listen SCMP’s Asia desk Published: 8:35pm, 3 Nov 2026 A German tourist was among two men still missing on Tuesday after a landslide struck a glamping resort on the island of Bali in Indonesia . Heavy rains on Sunday afternoon caused the landslide, which struck the Eco Park Pelaga Glamping Retreat in Petang district at around 11pm, The Bali Times reported. Three tents collapsed while a fourth fell into the Tukad Yeh Kilap River and was swept away by the currents.
 The 4-hectare (10-acre) property, which houses 25 tents, sits on a steep cliff beside the river, according to Antara news agency.
